title: Print se pehle *"OK" likhwa lo*. Hamesha.
message:
Hi [naam] 🖨️ aapke [cards/banner] ka proof 📎
Check karein: *naam, number, spelling, colour*.
Sab theek ho to *"OK PRINT"* reply karein.
OK ke baad badlaav = naya print.
why: "OK PRINT" likhit approval = galti pe *koi bahas nahi*. Aur customer dhyan se check karta hai.
caption:
Printing mein sabse mehngi galti: galat number, galat spelling, 500 copies. Aur phir bahas, kiski galti thi. 🖨️

Proof ka rule:
1️⃣ Proof WhatsApp pe bhejo
2️⃣ 4 cheezein check karne ko bolo
3️⃣ "OK PRINT" reply ke baad hi print

Save karo 🔖 apne staff ko bhi bhejo.
